evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We study this question with OccludeBench, a manually curated benchmark for recovering fully occluded objects from the visual evidence that remains.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Across five VLMs, accuracy averages 42.7% on direct cases versus 62.7% on inferential cases, exhibiting a 20.0-point gap.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: The bottleneck emerges when models must recover the relevant object from the projection within the full image: they succeed on only 50% of failed examples, compared with 91% of examples they answer correctly.
